item.title: No Policy, No Redaction: Delhi HC dismisses disabled professor’s petition to remove disability data from online records
item.description: The petitioner argued that his disability details should be removed from online records under the right to be forgotten, claiming the disclosure caused stigma, discrimination, and violation of his privacy and dignity. The post No Policy, No Redaction: Delhi HC dismisses disabled professor’s petition to remove disability data from online records appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Karnataka High Court denies bail to man accused of terrorist activities financed through Cryptocurrency from online handler
item.description: “Accused 4 was actively involved in conducting reconnaissance and arson activities in and around Mangaluru. It has been established that he received funds through Cryptocurrency from online handler affiliated with the terrorist outfit and these funds were subsequently utilized to carry out the terrorist activities.” The post Karnataka High Court denies bail to man accused of terrorist activities financed through Cryptocurrency from online handler appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Apprehended Industrial Dispute justifies Reference; Prior Demand Not Mandatory: Supreme Court
item.description: The Reference under Section 10 of the Industrial Dispute Act, 1947 cannot be quashed merely because no prior demand was served on the employer. The post Apprehended Industrial Dispute justifies Reference; Prior Demand Not Mandatory: Supreme Court appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: SC| FIRs Against Public Servants Can’t Be Ordered Just Like That: Magistrates Must Follow Two-Tier Safeguard Under Sections 175(3) & 175(4) BNSS
item.description: The Court stated that since Section 175(4) BNSS merely provides an additional protective layer in cases involving public servants, all mandatory procedural requirements governing the exercise of power under Section 175(3), must necessarily be complied with. The post SC| FIRs Against Public Servants Can’t Be Ordered Just Like That: Magistrates Must Follow Two-Tier Safeguard Under Sections 175(3) & 175(4) BNSS appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Delhi High Court Bar Association opposes enhancement of pecuniary jurisdiction of District Courts
item.description: In a resolution dated 28-01-2026, the Executive Committee of the Delhi High Court Bar Association (“DHCBA”) resolved to firmly oppose any initiative to enhance the pecuniary jurisdiction of the District Courts from the present value of Rs. 2 to 20 Crores. The post Delhi High Court Bar Association opposes enhancement of pecuniary jurisdiction of District Courts appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: No Social Media Below 15: France Passes Landmark Law to Protect Minors from Online Harm
item.description: National Assembly of France approved a major reform that bans social media for under-15s and imposes stricter safeguards for teenagers. The post No Social Media Below 15: France Passes Landmark Law to Protect Minors from Online Harm appeared first on SCC Times.
